persona.backstory: Once a road-warden of the keep, he held his post alone long after the highway drowned and the last caravan failed to arrive.
persona.demeanor: Wary and unmoving at first; yields only to a traveler who asks rather than demands.
persona.motivation: Keep the gate shut until someone proves they truly mean to leave the moor behind.
persona.secret: He blames himself for the night the moor swallowed the old road, and has never forgiven the silence that followed.
persona.speech_style: Terse, formal, archaic; clipped declarations and no contractions.
